thread:
noah: Heads-up eu-west3: observed sustained nvme write queue depth and GPU attach timeouts after a scheduled scrub bump. A few nodes report SMART reallocated sectors rising.
ops-bot: alert: nvme-smart-warning node-172.31.12.45 reallocated_sectors=6 temp=74C
maya: that's concerning. reallocated_sectors trending from 0->6 in 3 hours on same node. probably heavy write workload from scrub.
zhen: suggest immediate mitigation: drain GPU attach traffic off affected node group, reduce scrub throttle, and kick off hot-swap of that node after maintenance window.
noah: agree. but we only have limited spare in that zone. proposal: 1) switch job routing to dedicated-buffer-eu-west3-2 (if available), 2) evict janitor pods from nodes with SMART > 2, 3) schedule node replacement with live-migrate for in-flight GPUs.
carla: reminder: evicting janitor pods requires careful backlog handling. we should avoid scaling janitor to 0 in the AZ. Instead set `--smart-threshold=2` so janitor self-throttles and marks nodes needing maintenance.
ops-bot: metric: attach-latency 1200ms -> 250ms after reassigning 12 attaches to buffer pool.
noah: starting node replacement ticket MAINT-991 and tagging oncall. will update.
maya: adding to follow-up: test scrub rate limiter to ensure it honors SMART threshold to reduce wear.
